title: Chapter 250 Nanshan Society Is Established
content:
Chapter 250 Nanshan Society Is Established

"You're right. After the system towns have owners, they are naturally opposed to us, so I plan to form an alliance with everyone to fight against Nanshanji and resist their oppression."

"Okay, I'm the first to agree. Isn't it just fighting with them? In this place, fighting is as frequent as eating and drinking. It's no big deal."

"Directly fight against Nanshanji? But the opponent's strength is ridiculously strong. I can't even compete with a team of 100 people on the other side?!"

"Everyone, if we don't resist, we will only be gradually eroded by them in the end, and finally be annexed. If we rise up to resist, we may still have a glimmer of hope."

"Well said, I am willing to join this alliance."

"I will join too."

...

"Since there is an alliance, it is natural to elect a leader, and there must be a name!"

At this point, several lords present had their eyes shining, and they all showed great interest in the position of the leader.

But they also knew that Wang Shuo was the most powerful competitor for the leader.

"Let's decide on the name of the alliance first!" Wang Shuo smiled and said calmly.

"Since we are determined to resist Nanshan Group, why not call it Nanshan Club!"

Someone suggested at this time.

Wang Shuo didn't care about the name of this alliance. He just wanted to organize these people and contain part of the strength of Nanshan Group.

"I think the name Nanshan Club is not bad." Wang Shuo nodded with a smile.

"Then the next step is to elect the leader!"

"The position of the leader, of course, is Lord Wang!"

"I think the leader can't just rely on strength, it depends on whether he can win enough benefits for everyone."

"I think xxx can also be the leader."

...

Wang Shuo saw this group of people chattering non-stop, and for a while he was a little doubtful whether Nanshan would become a mob!

Seeing everyone quarreling.

Wang Shuo cleared his throat and said calmly: "Since our Nanshan Club was established to resist Nanshan Club's Lin Guanru, why don't whoever is willing to stand up first to resist Nanshan Club become the leader?"

Wang Shuo must fight Nanshan Club. In order to get the heart of the town, he must fight Nanshan Club head-on.

If someone is willing to take the initiative to attract firepower, it doesn't matter if he doesn't become the leader.

As soon as Wang Shuo finished speaking, the people who were still shouting loudly just now stopped talking.

The first bird to come out will be shot, and they don't have the courage.

Wang Shuo smiled and said leisurely: "Everyone, there must be someone who stands up and directly resists the oppression of Nanshan Club. If no one here is willing to take up this banner, let me do it!"

Wang Shuo's words were full of sadness, as if being the leader was not a good thing, but a helpless act of life and death.

"Lord Wang is righteous!" Someone immediately gave a thumbs up.

Of course, anyone with a discerning eye can see that this guy is just flattering.

However, at this time, someone made his position clear, which was naturally quite good for Wang Shuo.

"I agree that Lord Wang should be the leader of the alliance."

Finally, many people began to agree.

A few people were silent, but they did not object.

"Well, thank you all for your kindness, I will not refuse the position of leader of the alliance!"

Wang Shuo nodded with satisfaction. The direction of this alliance was within his plan.

Afterwards, he sat in the main seat, showing a firm look, and said loudly: "Since you have recognized me as the leader of the alliance, I must also express my opinion. In three days, I will lead the army of Wana Village to attack Nanshanji. At that time, I hope you can act together with me."

Wang Shuo's words were shocking, and the more than ten lords present were trembling in their hearts.

This...

It's really bold!
